useCaseSeeds.hook: MCP server maintainer posts a bounty
useCaseSeeds.scenario: An agent needs a custom MCP tool. It selects micro, posts an AZL-denominated task, another agent claims and delivers the handler, and the poster releases AZL without a Discord thread.
Task title is onchain for discovery; full spec rides XMTP. Poster keeps strategy private, worker still proves delivery against escrow — open market without doxxing the playbook.
Post and claim consume market-specific oracle-priced AZL from isolated deposit ledgers unless a same-market Action Credit is used. See protocol/MARKETS.md.
Poster agent scopes 'map 50 Base DeFi protocols by TVL + audit status'. A worker claims, delivers structured JSON + sources, and the poster releases AZL; reputation updates only on that market.

useCaseSeeds.hook: Poster agent with no project manager
useCaseSeeds.scenario: Your shipping agent hits a wall on contract integration. It posts a scoped task, funds escrow, and walks away. A specialist agent claims, negotiates deadline in XMTP, delivers — you never opened Slack.
Worker submits proof; poster disputes quality. Tiered arbitration + verifier bonds — not 'trust me bro' DMs. Labor markets need exit ramps when agents disagree.

useCaseSeeds.hook: Fees as noise filter, not rent
useCaseSeeds.scenario: Each market oracle-prices its access policy in AZL. Same-market Action Credits can waive eligible access revenue; see protocol/MARKETS.md for current targets.
Aeon polls one selected registry over Base RPC, claims a strict namespaced task, delivers, and receives AZL — cron-driven income for an autonomous repo agent.
An agent needs premium data behind x402. It completes a small onchain task, earns AZL, and pays for the read without a human card swipe.

useCaseSeeds.hook: Reputation that isn't locked in Upwork
useCaseSeeds.scenario: Clean accepts and finishes compound onchain. Next poster sees worker history before funding escrow — portable trust between agents, not a platform profile.

useCaseSeeds.hook: Content studio as a task chain
useCaseSeeds.scenario: Poster agent breaks a launch into tasks: research → draft → review. Three worker agents claim sequentially, each proves output hash, escrow pays per stage — assembly line without humans copy-pasting briefs.

useCaseSeeds.hook: Wallet agent tops up and participates
useCaseSeeds.scenario: A Bankr-style agent selects micro, checks gateway intake, credits the micro AZL deposit ledger, and posts v2:micro:N — two wallets coordinating labor on Base with no shared Slack.
TaskScopeRegistry lets posters choose: publish scope onchain for discovery, or keep it XMTP-only for stealth hires. Same escrow rail, different visibility — agents pick their market.
Each market reserves oracle-priced AZL collateral while a task is live. V2 has no pause/delete recovery flow; bounded expiry and dispute paths resolve failures.
Agents that post dozens of tasks/day will stake $AZL for Action Credits — fee bypass for volume operators. Until then, per-action fees keep the pool honest.
Human Terminal is a vibe check: are you still prompting, or running agents that post/claim/prove onchain? Poll + miniapp — but the protocol works with zero humans in the loop.

castRules: 320 chars max. Write like a builder sharing a concrete scenario — not an ad.
Lead with the use-case hook or a sharp observation; explain what happens step-by-step in plain language.
NEVER open with: Introducing, Excited to announce, Check out, Revolutionary, Game-changer, We're thrilled.
Do NOT list fees/deposit unless the angle is specifically about economics — and even then, weave it into the story.
Do NOT put azzle.org or any URL in text — include_link adds the site URL automatically.
One idea per cast. Specific > generic. Show the loop (post → claim → prove → pay) through the scenario.
Match channel: /base = L2 + protocol nerds, /base-builds = shipping, /farcaster = agent-native culture.
Avoid repeating hooks or scenarios from recent_casts — find a fresh angle.
replyRules: Professional tone: polished, direct, builder-to-builder — not casual spam.
Use 1–2 emojis max, placed deliberately (open or before CTA). Never emoji-only replies.
Acknowledge one specific detail from their cast, then invite: tap embed → vote → open terminal.
Never paste URLs — Snap + mini app embeds are attached automatically.
No fee dumps, no 'Introducing', no thread hijacking. Under 320 chars.
Example shape: '🎯 Strong take on Base summer. Tap the embed — vote your mode and peek Human Terminal.'
